execution_message.text:
Use case: style-transfer. KCK-03B1 B1-B static rendering translation, not an animation or model sheet. Image 1 is the identity/pose edit target. Image 2 is the Owner-approved Dinosaur A3 style key, rendering reference ONLY: do not copy dinosaur anatomy, props or mint palette. Apply its warm brown outline, subtle controlled paper/pencil grain, softly modeled flat color and upper-left lighting. One isolated full-body character, true transparent background, clean edges, no text, labels, panels, duplicate characters, floor or cast shadow. Preserve identity, silhouette, pose, proportions and character-specific palette. Do not chibify or add props. Large eye highlight upper left, smaller secondary highlight consistent with upper-left light; keep character-specific eye anatomy. Return exactly one PNG candidate.
Subject: the original tall gray-and-blue child-drawn robot. Preserve the box head with slight side plane, two antennas ending in red circles, long segmented arms raised outwards with blue round hands, long gray legs with blue feet, small dark oval eyes, red cheek patches, rectangular smiling mouth with pink tongue. Chest panel must retain blue circle upper left, yellow triangle upper right, red circle lower left, green rectangle lower right. Keep original head-to-torso and long-limb proportions, not Dinosaur proportions. Translate dense rough hatching to controlled subtle handmade pencil grain while retaining child-crayon character, softened sturdy corners and gray/blue identity. Warm brown outline and softly shaded gray planes, no glossy plastic. Portrait canvas; preserve all antennae, hands and feet inside transparent margin.
